fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole aluminum jon-style boat with outboard and trailer.
findings: Dirt and dust across the camo-painted floor and front casting deck
Debris and loose clutter in the rear area around the battery and fuel tank
Faded, dull flat green paint along the outer hull sides
Pink seat cushions look faded and soiled where they are piled in the middle
Grime and scuffing on the interior floor near the bow deck edge
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Alumacraft 1648 and it looks like a solid rig. The photos show some dirt across the floor and casting deck and a bit of clutter around the battery area in back. We do mobile pre-sale details that come to you, a good cleanout, wash and protectant so it shows its best. Would you like a quote?
